pages.html:
✦ Lumière
Home Shop About Contact

About Us

Our Story

Lumière was born from a love of slow living and the craft of candlemaking. In 2019, founder and head artisan Sophie Mercier began experimenting with natural waxes and fragrance blends in her small studio overlooking the countryside. What started as a personal passion quickly became a mission: to create candles that illuminate homes while honouring the environment and traditional craftsmanship.

Each candle is hand-poured in small batches, using sustainably sourced soy and beeswax blends. We believe in transparency, quality, and the transformative power of candlelight. Today, Lumière candles grace homes across the region, each one a testament to patience, care, and the beauty of handmade goods.

We are committed to keeping the art of candlemaking alive in an age of mass production. Every flicker tells a story of dedication and respect for nature.

Our Values & Process

🌱

Sustainably Sourced

We partner with ethical suppliers to source premium soy wax, beeswax, and essential oils. Every ingredient is chosen for its environmental and quality impact.

✋

Hand-Crafted

No machines, no shortcuts. Each candle is hand-poured and hand-finished by skilled artisans who take pride in their work and attention to detail.

💨

Natural Scents

We use 100% natural essential oils and sustainably harvested botanicals. Our fragrances are complex, long-lasting, and free from synthetic additives.

Meet the Artisans

Sophie Mercier

Founder & Lead Artisan

Sophie has been perfecting the craft of candlemaking for over six years. Her background in sustainable design and passion for natural materials guide every candle that leaves our studio.

Marcus Chen

Master Blender

Marcus brings 12 years of experience in perfumery and aromatherapy. He carefully curates and blends our essential oil combinations to create signature scents that evolve throughout the burn.

Elena Rossi

Designer & Packaging Specialist

Elena ensures that every candle is not only beautiful to burn but also beautiful to behold. Her sustainable packaging designs reflect Lumière's commitment to reducing environmental impact.

David Okafor

Quality Control & Craft Master

David meticulously inspects every batch to ensure our standards are met. With a background in artisanal crafts, he brings rigour and passion to every detail of our production.

Discover Our Collection

Experience the warmth and authenticity of Lumière candles. Each one is a small work of art, crafted with intention and care.

Browse the Shop

Business Hours

  • Saturday:

  • Sunday:

Shipping & Orders

Questions about your order? Check your email for tracking information, or contact us and we'll be happy to help track your package.

Send us a Message

* Required fields

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer custom candle orders?

Yes, we love working on custom projects! We can create bespoke candles for weddings, events, corporate gifts, and more. Please contact us with your vision and we'll provide a quote.

What's your shipping policy?

We ship orders within 2–3 business days. Domestic shipping typically takes 5–7 business days. All orders are packaged carefully to ensure your candles arrive in perfect condition.

Are your candles eco-friendly?

Absolutely. We use 100% natural soy wax, premium essential oils and fragrance, and recyclable/compostable packaging. Our candles are poured by hand in small batches with love and care.

Do you have wholesale options?

Yes! We work with boutique shops, spas, and retailers. Contact us to discuss wholesale pricing and minimum order quantities.

Can I return a candle?

We want you to love your candles. If there's any issue with your order, please contact us within 30 days and we'll make it right.

How long do your candles burn?

Our standard 8 oz candles burn for approximately 40–50 hours, depending on wick care and room ventilation. Larger sizes burn longer. Always trim the wick to 1/4 inch for best results.
